headline: El Niño and Fuel Costs Threaten Peru Poverty Relief Despite Fiscal Measures
summary: Peru's Ministry of Economy and Finance countercyclical plan aims to cushion shocks from El Niño and rising fuel prices, but risks failing to stop poverty from rising if inflation persists.
why: Peru's economy is highly sensitive to climate events like El Niño, which disrupt fishing and agriculture, while elevated fuel prices place strain on domestic inflation.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Persistent price pressures and climate disruptions pose risks to domestic economic activity and household purchasing power.
